title: Regular Expression Matching
summary: Match the entire string against the pattern.

contractDetails.constraints: s and p have lengths 1–20. s is lowercase English letters. p contains lowercase letters, dots, and asterisks. Each asterisk follows a letter or dot.

statement: Match the entire string against the pattern. A lowercase letter matches itself, a dot matches one character, and an asterisk repeats the immediately preceding letter or dot zero or more times.
constraints: s and p have lengths 1–20. s is lowercase English letters. p contains lowercase letters, dots, and asterisks. Each asterisk follows a letter or dot.
hints: Conceptual: An asterisk can discard its preceding token entirely.
Directional: Track reachable pairs of input and pattern prefixes.
Implementation: For a star, combine the zero-copy transition with the one-more-copy transition when its token matches.
complexityAnalysis: O(mn) time and O(n) space with rolling pattern-prefix rows.
